description: This file implements classes and functions related to blocking IPC closures, including factory methods for creating blocking closure objects, and specific implementations for polling and semaphore-based blocking closures within the firebolt::rialto::ipc namespace.

classes.name: BlockingClosurePoll
classes.description: Implements a blocking closure that uses polling on an IPC channel to process messages until a condition is met.

classes.name: BlockingClosureSemaphore
classes.description: Implements a blocking closure that uses a semaphore to synchronize execution, signaling completion via semaphore post and wait.

methods.name: IBlockingClosureFactory::createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a factory object for blocking closures.

methods.name: BlockingClosureFactory::createBlockingClosurePoll
methods.description: Creates a blocking closure object that polls on an IPC channel.

methods.name: BlockingClosureFactory::createBlockingClosureSemaphore
methods.description: Creates a blocking closure object that uses a semaphore for synchronization.

methods.name: BlockingClosurePoll::Run
methods.description: Sets the internal done flag to true, indicating the closure has completed.

methods.name: BlockingClosurePoll::wait
methods.description: Loops processing the IPC channel until the closure is marked as done.

methods.name: BlockingClosureSemaphore::Run
methods.description: Posts to the semaphore to signal completion.

methods.name: BlockingClosureSemaphore::wait
methods.description: Waits on the semaphore until signaled.
